_note: Decoded payload of the RS256 access token minted by the DDK reference Keycloak IdP (realm master) for the wallet round-trip. The raw JWT is never stored. Opaque per-session identifiers (jti/sub/sid) redacted; the test user's profile claims are synthetic (RFC 2606 .invalid). The claims that MATTER to wallet ingress are client_id and group (the wallet predicates) and aud (the JWT Validation audience boundary).
